statement: Is it true that every group $\Gamma$ for which the orders of finite subgroups are uniformly bounded satisfies the strong Atiyah conjecture; namely, for all positive integers $m,n$ and every $a\in M_{m,n}(\mathbb{C}\Gamma)$, the von Neumann dimension $\dim_{\mathrm{vN}}\ker a$ belongs to the subgroup of $\mathbb{Q}$ generated by $\{1/|H|:H\text{ is a finite subgroup of }\Gamma\}$?

technical_assessment_and_quantifiers: Requires dimension integrality for arbitrary such groups; finite matrices or torsion-free examples cannot establish the universal assertion. No full-scope mechanism found.

statement:

statement:

statement:

\]
Is $\alpha_k$ irrational for every $k\ge 1$?

technical_assessment_and_quantifiers: Factorial tails with divisor-power coefficients do not automatically have a nonintegral gap: coefficients grow and congruences matter. No all-k irrationality argument established.

statement: The Gasca–Maeztu conjecture asserts that every planar $GC_n$ set has a maximal line. statement: Let $V_1,\ldots,V_n$ be subvarieties of $\mathbb{C}^d$ and let $p_1,\ldots,p_n$ be polynomials in $\mathbb{C}[x]=\mathbb{C}[x_1,\ldots,x_d]$. statement:
